findings.obs_text: God is named as the one before whom, or toward whom, the meditation is set: before God in Job 15:4, acceptable in the sight of the Lord in Psa 19:14, pleasing to him in Psa 104:34, the law of the Lord in Psa 1:2, and God remembered in Psa 77:3.
In Pro 5:21 the Lord is named as the one who ponders: he weighs the paths of a man, whose ways are before his eyes.
People are named as the ones who meditate or ponder: Isaac in Gen 24:63, your servant in Psa 119:23, and in Act 10:19 the one pondering the vision, with the men who come to him named after it.
In 1Ki 18:27 the musing is said of a god, in Elijah's mockery: Elijah is named as the speaker, and the god of the others is the one who may be musing.
